summary: Frontend-only retest of the collapsed sidebar flyout z-index fix, desktop 1920x800, owner@palmhouse.com. On /dashboard, /reports/* and /expenses the fix works. Flyouts for Settings, Daily Report, Insights, Expenses and Aggregator render at x=70, w=240, on top of the main content (checked with elementFromPoint). Clicking outside closes them, clicking the parent again closes them, and sub-items navigate: Printers->/settings, Order Report->/reports/audit, Daily Sales->/reports-module/daily-sales, Add Expenses->/expenses. In expanded mode (280px) Settings opens inline children, no flyout appears, and inline Table Management navigates. Two problems remain: (1) on /settings the full-screen settings-panel (fixed z-50) covers the flyout; (2) the Insights flyout runs past the bottom of the viewport and its last items cannot be reached.

ui_bugs.issue: After Settings > Printers (or any settings sub-item), the settings-panel overlay (data-testid=settings-panel, 'fixed z-50') is open. Opening any collapsed-sidebar flyout (e.g. Daily Report) then renders BEHIND the panel. elementFromPoint at the flyout returns settings-tile-cancellation-reasons, and clicks on flyout items are blocked (Playwright reports that settings-panel intercepts pointer events). RCA: the flyout's z-[200] only applies inside the aside's stacking context, and the aside is z-20, so overall the flyout sits at z-20, below the z-50 fixed panel.

Insights has 38 children. The flyout's top is the button's Y (527px), and its height is maxHeight 70vh (560px), so its bottom is at ~1089px on an 800px viewport. Even after scrolling the inner list to the end, the last item (Food Court Beta) is at y=1049, off-screen and unreachable. The aside is sticky, so scrolling the page doesn't help. Settings and Reports end at ~785px, only just inside the viewport, and will clip on shorter screens.

action_items: Render the flyout through a React portal (createPortal to document.body) with position:fixed (left 70px, top = button rect.top) and a z-index above overlays like settings-panel (z-50). Alternatively raise the desktop aside z-index above 50, but check this doesn't put the aside over modals or dialogs. Retest by opening the flyout while on /settings with the panel open.

Clamp the flyout's vertical position to the viewport: top = min(buttonTop, window.innerHeight - flyoutHeight - 8), or anchor it to the bottom (bottom: 8px) when it would overflow. Also give the inner scroll area a max-height based on the space actually available, so every Insights item can be reached at 800px height.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx L714-725: the flyout is position:absolute inside the aside. Its z-[200] cannot escape the aside's z-20 stacking context. A portal plus fixed positioning is more robust.
Sidebar.jsx L642-646: flyoutTop is computed from the button rect and never clamped to window.innerHeight.
Sidebar.jsx is 900 lines; consider extracting the flyout into its own component.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (requested flows pass on dashboard; the flyout is hidden behind settings-panel on /settings; Insights bottom items can't be reached)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via data-testid login-email/login-password/login-button, then wait for [data-testid=sidebar]. Collapsed is the default on desktop; expand with [data-testid=expand-sidebar]. Flyout: [data-testid=sidebar-flyout], items are [data-testid=flyout-<id>]. Check visibility with document.elementFromPoint, not only bounding box. Reproduce bug 1: Settings flyout > Printers (opens settings-panel on /settings), then click sidebar-reports. Reproduce bug 2: at 1920x800 open sidebar-insights; the flyout bottom is past 800px.
rca of the issue: Original bug fixed: adding z-20 to the aside puts it above DashboardPage's 'overflow-hidden relative' main div. The remaining overlay issue happens because z-20 is lower than other fixed overlays (settings-panel z-50). The flyout is a descendant of the aside, so its z-[200] cannot lift it out.
